question: Who is the contact person in charge of Dormitory at VinUniversity?
strategy: Cấu hình đã chọn (Hybrid + Filter + Budget 1500)

results.text: Dormitory Assignment & Confirmation The Student Housing Office will review applications and assign accommodations based on availability and diversity considerations (college, nationality, and hometown). First-year students will receive a confirmation email with details about their dormitory placement, move-in date, and check-in procedures. Move-In & Orientation Upon arrival, students must check in at the Dormitory Management Office to receive their room key and dormitory regulations.

DORMITORY REGISTRATION GUIDE VinUniversity provides on-campus accommodation for all students as part of its co-living and co-learning model. To register for dormitory housing, follow the steps below: Receive Accommodation Information All students will receive an official notification via their VinUni email regarding dormitory registration. This notification will include a dormitory registration form, outlining available accommod-ation types, housing policies, and submission deadlines.
A dormitory orientation session will be conducted to help students settle in and understand dormitory policies. 19

question: Are international students covered by Vietnam's Social Insurance program for healthcare?
strategy: Cấu hình đã chọn (Hybrid + Filter + Budget 1500)

gold.evidence: However, since the Social Insurance program in Vietnam does not cover foreign national, you will need to purchase your own health insurance plan

results.text: At VinUniversity, you can freely access the medical clinic and the psychological counseling service for primary care. However, since the Social Insurance program in Vietnam does not cover foreign national, you will need to purchase your own health insurance plan from private companies for other health care services. At VinUni, the medical clinic can support in provide more information and advise on your health insurance plan.

We suggest the following insurance companies for their reputation and popularity in Vietnam: PVI Bảo Việt Insurance *You will need to submit all relevant medical and payment documents to your insurance company for the refund process.
